description: This Java source file defines a JUnit test case class for testing the 'performFind' service within the OFBiz framework. It contains various test methods that prepare test data, execute the service with different filters and conditions, and validate the results to ensure correct behavior of entity querying and filtering functionalities.

classes.name: PerformFindTests
classes.description: A JUnit test case class extending OFBizTestCase, designed to test the performFind service with various scenarios such as filtering, grouping, date filtering, and case sensitivity within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCompleteList
methods.description: Retrieves the complete list of entities from an EntityListIterator stored in the context map, handling exceptions and logging errors.

methods.name: prepareData
methods.description: Sets up test data in the database if it does not already exist, including testing types, testing values, nodes, and node memberships.

methods.name: createTestingValue
methods.description: Helper method to create a Testing entity with specified attributes in the database.

methods.name: testPerformFind
methods.description: Main test method invoking individual scenario tests for the performFind service.

methods.name: performFindConditionFieldEquals
methods.description: Tests the performFind service with various equality conditions on entity fields.

methods.name: performFindConditionFieldLike
methods.description: Tests the performFind service with LIKE, CONTAINS, and NOT-LIKE conditions for string matching.

methods.name: performFindConditionDistinct
methods.description: Tests the performFind service with and without DISTINCT clause to verify unique results.

methods.name: performFindFilterByDate
methods.description: Tests filtering entities based on date conditions and filter flags.

methods.name: performFindGroup
methods.description: Tests grouping conditions in performFind to retrieve entities matching multiple criteria.

methods.name: performFindGroupOrAnd
methods.description: Tests combined grouping with OR/AND operator in performFind.

methods.name: performFindDateFindAndIgnoreCase
methods.description: Tests date filtering with date range widgets and case-insensitive string matching.

methods.name: performFindFilterByDateWithDedicateDateField
methods.description: Tests filtering entities with custom date fields and conditional date filters.
